title: Power Apps: Browse data with automatic loading and numbered pages in Data Grid
description: Makers can configure the modern Data Grid in canvas apps to load more records automatically as users scroll or display numbered pages with a configurable page size. Existing apps retain their current behavior unless makers enable pagination. Connector and formula delegation limits still apply.
